ambient_events: The deep trunk runs straight and black in both directions, further than your light will reach.
Water moves through here with quiet, enormous confidence.
A chalk arrow on the wall points south. Someone wanted to be sure of the way.
description: The main deep trunk under the industrial east, a broad low tunnel that gathers every line in this quarter and carries it on toward the outfall. The Watch have marked the walls here in chalk — quiet, disciplined signs for people who know to read them — because this is the last easy stretch before their door. East ties into the conduit vault; south runs on to the deep reach.
name: Deep Trunk
